# R6.35 — E2-T3/E2-T4: `hh-tmpl/1` + the single compiled-`ModelSurface` request renderer (manifest 293)

Harness: devin-cli / swe-2-high / subagent — engineered (offline, $0.00)

Offline-only, zero-spend ticket. Stage 1 (commit `4969a4a5`) lands the
std-only `hh-tmpl/1` engine in its ADR-0442 home plus the
`prompt_layout.section_templates`/`roles`/`slots` compile surface; stage
2 (commit `a1c10c5c`) lands the single compiled-`ModelSurface` request
renderer — the arm is the `model_port.model_surface = "compiled"`
definition member; unarmed sessions render byte-identically. No spend,
no live claims, no `spec/` edits (`git diff --stat -- spec/` empty).

## Stage 1 — `hh-tmpl/1` (commit `4969a4a5`)

- **`crates/hh-compiler/src/tmpl.rs`** — the ADR-0442 subset over `Text`
  leaves, std-only (REQ-XE-112): `{{ ident(.ident)* }}` substitution;
  `{% if ident(.ident)* == "literal" %} … {% elif %} … {% else %} …
  {% endif %}` conditionals; Jinja whitespace-control `-` on either
  delimiter under `trim_blocks=false`, `lstrip_blocks=false`,
  `keep_trailing_newline=false`; strict undefined. Out-of-subset
  constructs — filters (`{{x|y}}`), loops (`for`/`endfor`), comments
  (`{#…#}`), `set`, bare/`is defined`/`!=`/non-literal comparisons,
  `+` markers, unterminated conditionals — fail compile as
  `TmplError::Unexpressible` (the `CompileError::UnexpressibleSurface`
  leg). An unfilled variable at render is `TmplError::Undefined` — a
  typed refusal, never an empty string (REQ-XE-113). Conditional
  subjects evaluate lazily in declared order (Jinja's short-circuit).
  The parser is pure — no clock, env, or host reads.
- **`lower_layout` (REQ-XE-104's compile half)** — `prompt_layout` gains
  `section_templates{section → node}` (explicit `Text`-leaf placement —
  the §5b.3 row-8 mini shape), `roles{section → provider role}` (a
  closed set `{system,user,assistant,tool}`; `system` requires the
  node's `definition` authority — §7.2's placement rule), and the
  existing `slots{section → [names]}`. A `hh-tmpl/1` leaf compiles its
  template at lower; its variable set must be a declared-slot subset,
  else `UnexpressibleSurface`.
- **`CompiledSection` gains `role` + `grammar`** — serialized
  absent-not-null (CC8), so definitions naming neither member emit
  byte-identical section JSON. `cargo tree -p hharness-compiler`
  unchanged — no new dependency (the ADR-0442 homes, no `hh-hir` edge).
- **Pinned fixtures** — `tests/fixtures/r6_35/{system,instance}
  _template.tmpl` are the post-YAML block scalars of the pinned
  `mini.yaml` (`SWE-agent/mini-swe-agent@a83fcae82d2a…`,
  `src/minisweagent/config/mini.yaml`, sha256
  `b539a8965f5bf41dd0f32daafa5d2db22581923d13812fa378fd09569b9d6b0c`
  verified). Parse test asserts the variable lists —
  instance: `{task, system, release, version, machine}` (mini's flat
  spellings; `uname.*` dotted forms stay admitted by the grammar and
  carry REQ-XE-113's declared-slot names).

## Stage 2 — the one renderer (commit `a1c10c5c`)

- **`model_port.model_surface ∈ {compiled}`** — admitted under the
  chat-completions family only at this stage (R6.34's staged-admission
  precedent); other values refuse typed. The arm is recorded on the
  manifest's `model_lane` member.
- **Arm is the pure compile** — `open` compiles the sealed definition +
  the realized role table's bound profile coordinates through the one
  `hharness_compiler::compile` path (`targets: []`; `Lowered` required —
  `Deferred`/failure is a typed refusal, never a silent unarmed
  downgrade). In-process takeover carries the surface; durable resume
  re-derives it by the same compile over the persisted sealed
  definition — the artifact is never persisted (CC1).
- **`GatewayModel::with_surface`** — `Some` ⇒ the request preamble
  renders the layout's sections in profile-declared order under their
  declared provider roles (`system` included); each `hh-tmpl/1` section
  fills at render time from `{task: instruction}` and the durable
  `action.environment.probe.completed` `values` (`uname.*` verbatim or
  under the `uname.` namespace). The prior-turn fold is the *same* code
  both paths run (a `transcript` slot marks the splice point; absent ⇒
  appended) — one renderer, no second message builder (CC1,
  REQ-XE-103/104).
- **`probe_uname_slots` (REQ-XE-113's run-time legs)** — a read-only,
  setup-phase in-cell probe through the first armed executor seam
  (before R6.38's `open_session.exec` — the ticket's permitted
  construction): `uname -s; uname -r; uname -v; uname -m` mints
  `action.environment.probe.{started,completed}` durable **before** the
  first request renders them (X-04); idempotent on re-drive; an
  unbacked probe (no exec surface, no env handle) mints
  `completed{outcome:"refused", reason:"probe_unbacked"}` — the slot
  stays unfilled and the render refuses `invalid_request`
  (`plan_error`) before any wire send.
- **`model_lane`/`SessionState`/`CarriedRuntime`** — the surface flows
  open → session → `drive()` (probe first, then `with_surface`); the
  `model_lane` member carries `model_surface:"compiled"` on the
  manifest.

## Tests

- `crates/hh-compiler/tests/r6_35.rs` — **9/9**: substitution /
  conditional / whitespace-control unit goldens (incl.
  `keep_trailing_newline`); eight out-of-subset refusals +
  strict-undefined render refusal; pinned `mini.yaml` parse + variable
  lists + both `Darwin` branch legs; compile-purity leg; layout
  placements (roles/grammar/source_node_ids/slots asserted, template
  source preserved unfilled — REQ-XE-113's never-at-compile leg) +
  undeclared-slot/section/role/node refusals.
- `crates/hh-embed/tests/r6_35.rs` — **4/4**: AC-3 two-path golden
  (unarmed body = `[user("do the thing")]` pre-change bytes; armed
  body = `[system, user]` per the compiled spec — `provenance:
  hand_derived`, REQ-XE-114); AC-4 mini-shaped turn-1 (two
  `definition`-authority sections → `system` + `user`, `{{task}}` ←
  instruction, uname values ← probe row, byte-compared); AC-5 the
  single-path pin (`surface_armed()`; the instruction appears nowhere
  the template doesn't name it — no fall-through exists); AC-2 probe
  rows durable pre-request with `probe.values == rendered substitution`,
  re-drive idempotent, unfilled slot → `invalid_request` plan_error +
  `call` refuses before the dead endpoint is touched, unbacked probe →
  `completed{refused}`.
- **Regression:** R6.34 battery 6/6 (wire-fidelity goldens unchanged);
  all `hharness-embed` and `hharness-compiler` suites green;
  `cargo fmt --all --check` clean.

## Deviations

- `lower_layout`'s `system`-role placement check reads the node's
  provenance authority (the value `seal` preserves), matching the
  routing side's authority read; a leaf-authority variant was drafted
  and corrected during the ticket.
- The `transcript` slot marks the prior-turn fold's splice point; a
  section not declaring it appends turns after the last section
  (mini's shape). Result/error renderers remain R6.37's work.
- Golden fixtures are `provenance: hand_derived` until the O-recorded
  corpus lands (REQ-XE-114) — never live evidence.

## Requirements

REQ-XE-103 (renderer home), REQ-XE-104 (layout/roles/section_templates),
REQ-XE-112 (hh-tmpl/1 + unexpressible legs), REQ-XE-113 (runtime slot
fill + probe + unfilled refusal) primary; REQ-XE-006, REQ-XD-123,
REQ-XE-114 contributing. AC-7.3-1/2/10/11 legs verified at fixture
level.
